profile_text.body:
Accenture plc is a public company traded under the ticker ACN and headquartered in Dublin, according to the company's registration details. Its own website describes it as embracing change to create what it calls 360 degree value and shared success for clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities, and says it works across industries using emerging technologies and human ingenuity.

The site's material centers on AI. Accenture writes about redesigning work and skills so that people and AI work together, about what it calls the Human + AI era, and about AI tokenomics, AI ROI and enterprise AI economics. It also addresses AI's power demands on data centers, AI driven cyber threats, and states that it is helping the European Commission's Directorate-General for International Partnerships scale AI across global operations. The site cites no specific figures for these efforts.

The record holds no tracked products, no lawsuits and no MCP servers for the company.
